nameOrigin: long hair around the neck of animals

pokedexEntries.ru: MANECTRIC is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this POKéMON creates thunderclouds.

pokedexEntries.sa: MANECTRIC discharges strong electricity from its mane. The mane is used for collecting electricity in the atmosphere. This POKéMON creates thunderclouds above its head.

pokedexEntries.frlg: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

pokedexEntries.em: Because lightning falls in their vicinities, MANECTRIC were thought to have been born from lightning. In battle, they create thunderclouds.

pokedexEntries.dpp: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

pokedexEntries.hgss: Its nest can be found where a thunderbolt hits. It is discharging electricity from its mane.

pokedexEntries.bw: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

pokedexEntries.x: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

pokedexEntries.y: It discharges electricity from its mane. It creates a thundercloud overhead to drop lightning bolts.

pokedexEntries.or: Manectric is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokémon creates thunderclouds.

pokedexEntries.as: Manectric discharges strong electricity from its mane. The mane is used for collecting electricity in the atmosphere. This Pokémon creates thunderclouds above its head.

pokedexEntries.us: Manectric can be found beneath unnatural thunderclouds. People say it can run at the same speed as lightning striking.

pokedexEntries.um: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

pokedexEntries.sw: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.

pokedexEntries.sh: It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.

pokedexEntries.bdsp: It discharges electricity from its mane. The Pokémon creates a thundercloud overhead from which to drop lightning bolts.

pokedexEntries.za: It discharges electricity from its mane. The Pokémon creates a thundercloud overhead from which to drop lightning bolts.
